title: Westcott AC Power Adapter AC100-240V TO DC 9V 1A HEAVEN-H13US9VU
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:Multipurpose Batteries & Power:Multipurpose AC to DC Adapters
descriptionText: This Westcott AC Power Adapter is the perfect solution for powering your devices without the need for batteries. With a 1:3 connection split/duplication and a black color, it is a versatile addition to your electronics. The adapter is powered and has an output voltage of 9V, making it suitable for a variety of devices. It is a type of AC/DC adapter and is sold as a custom bundle with no additional accessories included.
